about: X12 (a2): "Check wait codes" on twin-single.nc under "Twin 31i lines" (partners read from the P word): the findings of (a) plus the unknown-channel finding.
title: Wait codes, Twin 31i lines: 5 to look at

rows.text: M130: Channel 1 waits on it 2 times for Channel 2, Channel 2 has 1; both need the same number.
M140 (line 37) and M141 (line 39) are in the other order in Channel 2 (lines 52 and 50).
M150 in Channel 1 waits for Channel 2, but Channel 2 has no M150 that waits for Channel 1.
M170 in Channel 1 names “3”, which is not a channel of this machine.
M160 in Channel 2 waits for Channel 1, but Channel 1 has no M160 that waits for Channel 2.
